previewGroupSqlQueries.sql:
SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name) AS canonical_name,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug) AS canonical_slug,
        MAX(cm.hang_xe) AS brand,
        MAX(cm.ten_xe) AS model,
        COUNT(DISTINCT `p`.`id`) AS total_count,
        MAX(COALESCE(pc.search_priority, 0)) AS search_priority
      
    FROM products p

    LEFT JOIN product_category_map pcm
      ON pcm.product_id = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN product_categories pc
      ON pc.id = pcm.category_id

    LEFT JOIN product_car_applications pa
      ON pa.productId = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN car_models cm
      ON cm.id = pa.carModelId

    JOIN shops s
      ON `s`.id = `p`.`shopId`

    LEFT JOIN address a
      ON a.id = s.provinceId
  
       WHERE 1=1  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.hang_xe)) = ? 
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
           AND TRIM(LOWER(`s`.`public_status`)) = 'public' AND TRIM(LOWER(`p`.`moderation_status`)) = 'approved' AND `p`.`stock` > 0 
      GROUP BY
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug),
        cm.hang_xe,
        cm.ten_xe
      HAVING total_count > 0

SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name) AS canonical_name,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug) AS canonical_slug,
        COUNT(DISTINCT `p`.`id`) AS total_count,
        MAX(COALESCE(pc.search_priority, 0)) AS search_priority
      
    FROM products p

    LEFT JOIN product_category_map pcm
      ON pcm.product_id = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN product_categories pc
      ON pc.id = pcm.category_id

    LEFT JOIN product_car_applications pa
      ON pa.productId = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN car_models cm
      ON cm.id = pa.carModelId

    JOIN shops s
      ON `s`.id = `p`.`shopId`

    LEFT JOIN address a
      ON a.id = s.provinceId
  
       WHERE 1=1  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.hang_xe)) = ? 
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
           AND TRIM(LOWER(`s`.`public_status`)) = 'public' AND TRIM(LOWER(`p`.`moderation_status`)) = 'approved' AND `p`.`stock` > 0 
      GROUP BY
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug)
      HAVING total_count > 0

       WHERE 1=1  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.hang_xe)) = ?  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.ten_xe)) = ?

            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?

SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name) AS canonical_name,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug) AS canonical_slug,
        MAX(cm.hang_xe) AS brand,
        MAX(cm.ten_xe) AS model,
        COUNT(DISTINCT `p`.`id`) AS total_count,
        MAX(COALESCE(pc.search_priority, 0)) AS search_priority
      
    FROM products p

    LEFT JOIN product_category_map pcm
      ON pcm.product_id = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN product_categories pc
      ON pc.id = pcm.category_id

    LEFT JOIN product_car_applications pa
      ON pa.productId = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN car_models cm
      ON cm.id = pa.carModelId

    JOIN shops s
      ON `s`.id = `p`.`shopId`

    LEFT JOIN address a
      ON a.id = s.provinceId
  
       WHERE 1=1  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.hang_xe)) = ?  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.ten_xe)) = ? 
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
          
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
          
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
           AND TRIM(LOWER(`s`.`public_status`)) = 'public' AND TRIM(LOWER(`p`.`moderation_status`)) = 'approved' AND `p`.`stock` > 0 
      GROUP BY
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug),
        cm.hang_xe,
        cm.ten_xe
      HAVING total_count > 0

SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name) AS canonical_name,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug) AS canonical_slug,
        COUNT(DISTINCT `p`.`id`) AS total_count,
        MAX(COALESCE(pc.search_priority, 0)) AS search_priority
      
    FROM products p

    LEFT JOIN product_category_map pcm
      ON pcm.product_id = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN product_categories pc
      ON pc.id = pcm.category_id

    LEFT JOIN product_car_applications pa
      ON pa.productId = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN car_models cm
      ON cm.id = pa.carModelId

    JOIN shops s
      ON `s`.id = `p`.`shopId`

    LEFT JOIN address a
      ON a.id = s.provinceId
  
       WHERE 1=1  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.hang_xe)) = ?  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.ten_xe)) = ? 
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
          
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
          
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
           AND TRIM(LOWER(`s`.`public_status`)) = 'public' AND TRIM(LOWER(`p`.`moderation_status`)) = 'approved' AND `p`.`stock` > 0 
      GROUP BY
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug)
      HAVING total_count > 0

SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name) AS canonical_name,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug) AS canonical_slug,
        MAX(cm.hang_xe) AS brand,
        MAX(cm.ten_xe) AS model,
        COUNT(DISTINCT `p`.`id`) AS total_count,
        MAX(COALESCE(pc.search_priority, 0)) AS search_priority
      
    FROM products p

    LEFT JOIN product_category_map pcm
      ON pcm.product_id = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN product_categories pc
      ON pc.id = pcm.category_id

    LEFT JOIN product_car_applications pa
      ON pa.productId = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN car_models cm
      ON cm.id = pa.carModelId

    JOIN shops s
      ON `s`.id = `p`.`shopId`

    LEFT JOIN address a
      ON a.id = s.provinceId
  
       WHERE 1=1  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.hang_xe)) = ? 
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
          
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
           AND TRIM(LOWER(`s`.`public_status`)) = 'public' AND TRIM(LOWER(`p`.`moderation_status`)) = 'approved' AND `p`.`stock` > 0 
      GROUP BY
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug),
        cm.hang_xe,
        cm.ten_xe
      HAVING total_count > 0

        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug) AS canonical_slug,
        COUNT(DISTINCT `p`.`id`) AS total_count,
        MAX(COALESCE(pc.search_priority, 0)) AS search_priority
      
    FROM products p

    LEFT JOIN product_category_map pcm
      ON pcm.product_id = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN product_categories pc
      ON pc.id = pcm.category_id

    LEFT JOIN product_car_applications pa
      ON pa.productId = `p`.`id`

    LEFT JOIN car_models cm
      ON cm.id = pa.carModelId

    JOIN shops s
      ON `s`.id = `p`.`shopId`

    LEFT JOIN address a
      ON a.id = s.provinceId
  
       WHERE 1=1  AND LOWER(TRIM(cm.hang_xe)) = ? 
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
          
          AND (
            LOWER(`p`.`partName`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`shortDescription`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`description`) LIKE ?
            OR LOWER(`p`.`partNumber`) LIKE ?
          )
           AND TRIM(LOWER(`s`.`public_status`)) = 'public' AND TRIM(LOWER(`p`.`moderation_status`)) = 'approved' AND `p`.`stock` > 0 
      GROUP BY
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_name, ''), pc.category_name),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.canonical_slug, ''), pc.category_slug)
      HAVING total_count > 0
